description: Remove the inert supervisor session_id field and the dead vendored stop-hook left over from the retired stop-hook driver architecture (CAM-22).

userStories.title: Drop session_id from state-file writer + vendored template
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the supervisor to stop generating and writing the inert session_id field into .claude/cam-loop.local.md so that the loop state file stops carrying a vestige of the retired stop-hook architecture (the supervisor lock at .claude/.cam-supervisor.lock is the real session-isolation primitive; workers get a fresh uuid; the orchestrator session id lives at .cam-orch-session).
acceptanceCriteria: vendor/cam-loop.local.md.tmpl no longer contains the `session_id:` frontmatter line or the `{{SESSION_ID}}` placeholder.
src/commands/next.ts renderStateFile() no longer accepts a sessionId input field, no longer performs the `{{SESSION_ID}}` replace, and no longer writes session_id into stateFileBase.

src/commands/next.ts no longer reads `options.sessionId` / `process.env.CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` / synthesizes a crypto.randomUUID() for the supervisor session id (the variable is removed; it was used for nothing else).

test/next.test.ts and test/interactivity/interactivity.test.ts are updated to stop asserting on `session_id:` in the rendered state-file body; they still assert the other frontmatter fields (active, iteration, max_iterations, started_at, pid, completion_promise).
src/vendor/_generated.ts is regenerated via `bun run embed-vendor` so the embedded copy of the template matches the new on-disk vendor file.

DO NOT touch src/commands/run.ts session_id handling (`.cam-orch-session` + `claude --session-id` ~lines 144-155): that is the orchestrator's active claude session id, unrelated to the inert supervisor field.

src/commands/next.ts header comments (~lines 6, 18, 32) and the in-function comment (~line 392) drop the `session_id` field name and the retired-stop-hook references; the rest of the architectural prose stays intact (CLAUDE.md §7 Doc Maintenance).
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check)
userStories.notes: Files: vendor/cam-loop.local.md.tmpl (drop line 4 + the {{SESSION_ID}} placeholder), src/commands/next.ts (~line 154 sessionId field, ~line 181 {{SESSION_ID}} replace, ~lines 393-394 supervisorSessionId derivation, ~line 402 sessionId arg into renderStateFile, ~line 427 stateFileBase), src/vendor/_generated.ts (regenerate), test/next.test.ts (`expect(out).toContain('session_id: sess-abc')` at ~line 69, `parsed['session_id']` at ~line 122, ~line 221 `session_id: shape-test`), test/interactivity/interactivity.test.ts (~line 291 + ~line 389 + ~line 448 `session_id:` fixture lines and assertion). After editing the .tmpl, run `bun run embed-vendor` and commit the regenerated `src/vendor/_generated.ts` in the same commit as the template change so vendor-drift never goes red. Per AGENTS.md: noUncheckedIndexedAccess is strict — when removing the sessionId arg from renderStateFile(), make sure no caller still passes it. The vendored stop-hook in src/vendor/_generated.ts still references session_id; do NOT touch that string here, US-003 deletes the whole stop-hook embed.

userStories.title: Drop session_id from state-file readers and inert references
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the state-file parser, the LoopState type, and the inert resume/status header comments to stop carrying the dead session_id field so the type signature reflects reality and old-state-file back-compat still holds (the field is silently ignored on read, not asserted absent).
acceptanceCriteria: src/commands/status.ts LoopState interface no longer declares `session_id?: string` (~line 97).

src/commands/status.ts parseStateFile() no longer copies `session_id` into the LoopState output (~line 223). It MUST still parse cleanly when an OLD state file contains a `session_id:` line: the line is silently ignored (typeof-guard pattern, no throw).

src/commands/status.ts header comment (~line 9) and the stop-hook reference at ~line 67 are updated to remove the dead `session_id` field name from the documented frontmatter list (per the runbook canonical list).
src/commands/resume.ts header comment (~line 10) stops listing `session_id` as a state-file frontmatter field; classifyResumeMode logic is unchanged because it never used the field.

test/status.test.ts is updated to stop asserting `session_id: 'sess-abc'` in the LoopState shape (~line 89) but a new assertion confirms that an old state file containing `session_id: legacy-value` still parses to a LoopState without that key (back-compat smoke).
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck)
Tests pass (bun test)
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/status.ts (LoopState ~line 97, parseStateFile ~line 223, header comment ~line 9, stop-hook ref comment ~line 67), src/commands/resume.ts (header comment ~line 10), test/status.test.ts (~line 76 fixture line, ~line 89 LoopState assertion, ~line 238 fixture line). Dashboard.tsx and dashboard.ts were already confirmed to NOT reference session_id (verified with grep) — no edit needed there. Back-compat constraint per the re-grounded scope: readers must NOT throw on an OLD state file that still HAS session_id; the existing typeof-guard pattern naturally accomplishes that by simply not copying unknown keys. Add a tiny test fixture proving the back-compat. Per CLAUDE.md: comment-driven assumptions are not proof — verify by reading the parseStateFile() body in this story to confirm the guard pattern, then run `bun test test/status.test.ts` to confirm both new and old fixtures parse.
